audits.title: Gracedale Operations & Compliance Audit 2024

findings.title: Critical Nursing Staff Shortages
findings.description: Facility operating at approximately 80% of required nursing positions unfilled. RN coverage fell below PA Department of Health minimum standards on 47 documented occasions during the audit period. Agency staff usage increased 340% year-over-year.
findings.recommendation: Implement comprehensive recruitment and retention program; consider competitive wage increases
findings.managementResponse: Actively recruiting; working with staffing agencies; requested County Council budget increase for wages

findings.title: CMS Quality Rating Decline
findings.description: Facility's CMS Five-Star Quality Rating dropped to 1-star (much below average) from 2-star in previous evaluation. Health inspection rating: 1 star. Staffing rating: 1 star. Quality measures: 2 stars.
findings.statuteName: CMS Requirements for Long-Term Care Facilities

findings.title: Infection Control Protocol Deficiencies
findings.description: Documented lapses in infection control protocols including incomplete hand hygiene compliance logs and PPE usage documentation.

findings.title: Resident Care Plan Documentation Gaps
findings.description: 18% of sampled resident care plans were not updated within required 90-day intervals.

recommendations: Increase nursing wages to competitive market rates
Implement electronic care plan tracking with automated alerts
Request CMS consultation on quality improvement

findings.title: Nursing Staff Recruitment Challenges
findings.description: Initial documentation of staffing difficulties - 15% vacancy rate in nursing positions

controllerFlags.description: Recurring nursing staff shortages affecting resident care - 80% vacancy rate, CMS 1-star rating
controllerFlags.requiredAction: Controller review; recommend County Council budget hearing on Gracedale staffing crisis
controllerFlags.legalImplications: Potential CMS sanctions, state survey citations, civil money penalties

metadata.dataSource: CMS Nursing Home Compare, PA DOH Survey Reports, County Controller
